Health811

Health811 is a free, secure, and confidential service for people in Ontario to receive health advice from a registered nurse or find health services. It is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week via phone or online chat.

Confirm before you go. Available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Does not replace your other touch point with your health care provider. In a medical emergency call 911 immediately.
